text: Map online. Russian forces advanced in Mala Tokmachka, Novodanylivka (already reported on X), in Petrivka (south of Druzhkivka), and captured the forest north of Okhrimivka. The villages of Hirke (Omelnyk direction), Kutuzivka/Stepy and Vilne (Dobropillya direction) were fully captured by the RuAF.
Added polygon area and more drawing tools.
Added more captured city markers. Russians advanced into Mohritsya and north of Kostiantynivka (32.1km²).
